content:
Elaine Park: Quick sync — putting final touches on first-run quickstart banner + sample-project picks. Two microcopy variants below. Want accessibility and devex signoff before we ship today.

Samir Gupta: Pasting variants:

Variant A: "Get started with a sample project — deploy in minutes."
Variant B: "Spin up a demo app with one click — try the default sample."

Miguel Torres: I'm worried 'deploy' and 'one click' might promise more than we support for private installs. Maybe 'launch' or 'open'?

Kevin Zhao: Frontend: Banner will be 640px wide, CTA is a button with role=button. I'll add aria-label. Example:

```html
<button aria-label="Open sample project: todo-app">Try sample project</button>
```

Ava Singh: Accessibility nits: ensure focus ring visible, high-contrast text, and don't rely on color alone. Also the banner must be dismissible with keyboard (Esc) and have aria-live for updates.

Liam Chen: From PM: prefer Variant B but change to "Launch a demo app" and secondary link 'See sample projects' that opens a drawer.

Samir Gupta: Updated copy suggestion: "Launch a demo app — try a curated sample project in seconds."

Elaine Park: OK sounds good. Miguel — can we avoid 'seconds' maybe 'in seconds' is fine if typical time <10s. We should be conservative.

Miguel Torres: For hosted it's seconds, for dedicated might be minutes. Suggest: 'in a few clicks' instead.

Kevin Zhao: I'll implement A11y changes and the drawer. Will add `aria-live="polite"` to the banner and ensure `role="dialog"` for the drawer.

deploy-bot: @channel Deploy started for branch `prod/onboard-banner-v3` — 1 job running :rocket:

Elaine Park: Great. Final copy approved: "Launch a demo app — try a curated sample project in a few clicks." Secondary CTA: "Browse sample projects".

Ava Singh: I'll run a quick axe scan and keyboard nav test after deploy. If any failures, we'll revert.

deploy-bot: Build succeeded — all checks passed :white_check_mark:

Liam Chen: Thanks team — shipping now. :tada:
